title: DiffPTS: Rethinking Diffusion ELBO for Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.32363v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Probabilistic time series forecasting requires modeling and predicting complex and time-varying distributions. Recently, Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM)-based approaches have shown promise by equipping the dif- fusion process with pretrained mean and variance estimators to accommodate distributional shift. However, these methods typically follow the standard DDPM framework and consider only partial components of the evidence lower bound (ELBO), treating the training of estimators as designed regression tasks separate from the variational inference framework. translated_title: DiffPTS：重新思考用于概率时间序列预测的扩散模型证据下界（ELBO）
translated_abstract: 概率时间序列预测需要对复杂且随时间变化的分布进行建模和预测。近年来，基于去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）的方法展现出良好的前景，这类方法通过为扩散过程配备预训练的均值和方差估计器来适应分布偏移。然而，这些方法通常遵循标准的 DDPM 框架，仅考虑证据下界（ELBO）的部分组成部分，并将估计器的训练视为与变分推断框架相分离的、人为设计的回归任务。为解决这一问题，我们在位置-尺度噪声模型（LSNM）下重新审视 ELBO，发现它能够自然地为估计器导出一个高斯负对数似然目标，并内在地定义了一个联合训练目标，该目标统一了近期用于概率预测的各种扩散范式。基于这一具有理论依据的 ELBO 重构，我们提出了 DiffPTS（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文通过在位置-尺度噪声模型下重新推导扩散模型的证据下界（ELBO），提出了 DiffPTS，将估计器的训练与变分推断统一为一个自然的联合训练目标，从而改进概率时间序列预测。
en_tdlr: DiffPTS rethinks the diffusion ELBO under the Location-Scale Noise Model, unifying estimator training and variational inference into a principled joint objective for probabilistic time series forecasting.
